Join "Pie Mates" – Mud Foods' Affiliate Program!

Are you passionate about great food and looking to share that love with the world? Mud Foods invites you to join "Pie Mates," our exciting affiliate program designed for food enthusiasts and influencers alike!

Brand Introduction:

At Mud Foods, we're all about crafting delicious, hearty, and soul-warming food that brings joy to every meal. Our passion for quality ingredients and authentic flavours is what sets us apart. We believe in the magic of a well-made pie, and we pour our hearts into creating culinary delights that satisfy and comfort.

Product Description:

From our mouth-watering Chicken & Leek Pie to our rich and savoury Steak & Ale Pie, Mud Foods offers a variety of scrumptious options that cater to every taste. Our pies are crafted with care, using locally sourced ingredients to ensure every bite is fresh, flavourful, and bursting with goodness.

Unique Selling Point (USP):

What makes Mud Foods stand out? It's our unwavering commitment to quality and taste. We source the finest local ingredients and blend them into recipes that have been perfected over time. Each pie is a testament to our dedication to excellence and our love for creating food that feels like a warm hug from the inside out.

Calling All Content Creators!

We're on the lookout for dynamic videos showcasing real people trying our delectable pies. We want to see your genuine reactions, your joyful moments, and your creative spins on how you enjoy Mud Foods' pies. Whether it's a family dinner, a cozy night in, or a festive gathering, show us how Mud Foods makes your meals special!

Join "Pie Mates" today and become part of a community that celebrates the simple joys of good food. Let's share the love, one delicious pie at a time!

Sign Up Now and Start Sharing the Pie Love!

Visit Mud Foods Affiliate Program to learn more and join our growing family of food enthusiasts. Together, we can make every meal a little more magical.

Become a "Pie Mate" and let’s create something deliciously wonderful together!

Account Registration & Terms 

You must provide your full legal name, a valid email address, and any other information we request to complete the sign up process for an Affiliate account (“account”). 

You must be 18 years of age or older to join this Scheme. 

Each account is for use by either a single company, partnership or individual user. You may not use the Scheme for any illegal or unauthorized purpose. You must not, in the use of the Scheme, violate any laws in your jurisdiction (including but not limited to copyright laws).

Once you have signed up for the Scheme, you will be provided with a URL link that must be used to identify you when placing a link from your website, email marketing or other communications methods to the Mud Foods Ltd website. Please ensure this link is correctly formatted. 

We may provide graphics, photos or other images that can be used within the links to promote Mud Foods. You may not modify these images in any way. We reserve the right to ask you to change or withdraw the images at any time without notice.

  • misrepresent or embellish the relationship between us and you

  • say you are part of Mud Foods Ltd or imply any relationship between us and you, except as expressly permitted by this Agreement 

Promotion expectations 

As an internet-based company, online promotion is important to us. Our affiliates are expected to produce 1-2 social media YouTube videos/social posts per month featuring Mud Food, using language that is universally acceptable to people of all ages and backgrounds.

This Agreement stipulates that all activity will be truthful about Mud Foods Ltd products, even if you have issues or suggestions of improvements we can make. This feedback is beneficial and important to us for our product development and reputation/credibility. We are happy to receive feedback prior to publication to allow affiliates to provide an update within their posts/videos with our response along the lines of “we’ve contacted Mud Foods Ltd about this and they have said…”.

Affiliates are expected to tag Mud Foods Ltd in the posts and show/mention Mud Foods Ltd in the videos. You must also declare your affiliate status according to the laws of each jurisdiction in which you and we operate.

Any questions and comments received on the posts/videos must receive a reply within 48 hours, so please schedule your posts according to your ability to monitor engagement with them. Should questions arise that affiliates are not able to answer, they should be forwarded immediately to piemates@mudfoods.com. We will reply as soon as we can, usually within 24 hours (excluding weekends and bank holidays). Please do not provide an answer that you are not confident is accurate as this may undermine our brand reputation.

Affiliates are expected to ensure that any offensive/obviously untrue/defamatory comments made about other users or Mud Foods Ltd are deleted immediately from all channels so as not to cause distress to other users. 

Referral Fees 

For the sale of our products to be eligible to earn a referral fee, the customer must click-through a link from your site, email, or other communications to the Mud Foods Ltd website. 

We will only pay referral fees on links that are automatically tracked and reported by our systems. For our systems to track the referral, the visitor must have cookies enabled. We will not pay referral fees if someone says they signed up through you but it was not tracked by our system. 

The referral fee is 10% of our revenue (excluding VAT and other charges) from customers that you refer, rising to 20% when certain thresholds are met. Affiliates are advised of this point when they join. The referral fee will be credited to your Affiliate account once the customer has completed their transaction. Referral fees are only earned if a customer makes a payment in full.

Accrued referral fees are paid via bank transfer once per month. You will then raise an invoice to Mud Foods Ltd for the accrued amount. You must have a valid bank account to receive referral fees by bank transfer; we do not pay by cheque, credit card or cash. 

Refunded customer purchases or payments charged-back due to credit card fraud do not qualify for referral fees. We may delay crediting referral fees according to risk analysis considerations and Anti-Money Laundering procedures. 

A summary of sign ups and statement of referral fees will be available to the Affiliate by logging into their Affiliate account. 

The referral fee structure is subject to change at our discretion. 

We reserve the right to disqualify referral fees earned through fraudulent, illegal, or overly aggressive, questionable sales or marketing methods.

We may change our policies and operating procedures at any time.
